content: ENGINE BUILD COMPLETE: ENT09 International Trade Engine v1.0.0 deployed on port 9149. 1440 lines. 18 doctrine blocks covering EAR export controls (15 CFR 730-774), ITAR defense articles (22 CFR 120-130), OFAC sanctions (31 CFR 500-599), HTS tariff classification, FCPA anti-bribery (15 USC 78dd), USMCA rules of origin (19 CFR 182), antidumping/countervailing duties (19 USC 1673/1671), Section 301 China tariffs, Section 232 steel/aluminum tariffs, foreign trade zones (19 CFR 146), customs valuation (19 USC 1401a), deemed export controls (15 CFR 734.13), Incoterms 2020, voluntary self-disclosure, import licensing/quotas, country of origin marking (19 USC 1304), letters of credit (UCP 600), trade compliance audits/recordkeeping. All TIE-20 components implemented. Three-layer response, response modes (FAST/DEFENSE/MEMO), authority hardening, confidence stratification (DEFENSIBLE/AGGRESSIVE/DISCLOSURE/HIGH_RISK), zoned analysis (PLANNING/REPORTING/AUDIT), telemetry, drift watcher, coverage map, metrics, SHA-256 determinism, audit trail JSONL. Tested with export control and sanctions queries. All quality gates passed (7/7 = 100%). Status: PASSED in build orchestrator.
